Version 0.23.0 (10/29/26)
Console support: play with a controller
Troop Spawner Rework
Infinite pays 1.5x coins, keep everything when you leave
Halloween Hunt: earn BOTH Halloween skins (fixed)
Buffs: Battle Tank, SPG-9, Farms
Nerfs: Marksman, Gunship rockets
Conscripts get armor-piercing at max level
Fixes: Sand Worm, boss bars, saves, KPV, tank MG

New towers coming soon...

The infection is spreading. Hold the line.

Trench Line is a co-op zombie tower defense game. Build your defenses, upgrade your troops and stop the infected before they break through.

BUILD YOUR LINE
Deploy riflemen, machine gunners, snipers, mortars, tanks and helicopter gunships.

SURVIVE THE HORDE
Fight off shamblers, runners, armored infected and massive Brutes.

✅ Easy ✅ Medium ✅ Hard ☠️ENDLESS☠️
Squad up with friends and hold the trench together.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!
Thanks to our dev team.
